page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes run as indented notes inside the text block (set in smaller italic type under the paragraph they belong to). Running head at top centre "cum Notis selectis." with page number 393 at right. Signature "Bb 5" at foot, catchword "Duas" at lower right.

main_text.p: §. 5. Sororem quoque patris ac matris vxo-res accipere non licet.
Sororem quoque patris ] id est, amitam §. 2. Inst. de nupt. l. 17. in fin. ff. de ritu.
Ac matris ] id est, materteram. d. §. 5. d. l. 1. ff. de ritu l. 17 C. de nupt.
§. 6. Genero quoque socrum suam: nec soc-cero nurum vxorem accipere licet, neque vi-trico privignam, neque privigno nouercam.
Socrum suam ] §. 7. Instit. de nupt. l. 17. C. de nuptiis.
Nec socero nurum ] §. 6. Institut. de nupt. d. l. 17. l. 5. in fin. ff. de condict. sine causa l. 38. ff. de adulteriis.
Vitrico privignam ] d. §. 6. verf. Item si adhuc privigna. l. 5. in fin ff. de condict sine causa. l. 14. in fin. l. 40. ff. de ritu. l. 38. ff. de adult. l. 17. C. de nupt. Gothofr.
- Neque privigno nouercam ] l. 38 ff. de adult. Novel. 115. c. 3. §. 5. l. 17. C. de nupt.
§. 7. Fratres enim amitinos vel consobri-nos, in matrimonium iungi nulla ratione per-mittitur.
Nulla ratione permittitur ] Imo permittitur. §. 4. Instit. de nupt. vid. Gothofr. ad leg. 19. Cod. de nupt.
§. 8. Sed nec vni viro duas sorores vxores habere, nec vni mulieri duobus fratribus iungi permittitur.

page.notes: Marginal notes are printed as small italic annotations; they are given above as type="foot" paragraphs at the points where they stand. Partly faded print in several lines; the reference "Gothofr." and citations are read as printed. Handwritten "256" at top right is not transcribed.
